facts.fact: The Patriot reports that BOCRA's compulsory SIM registration in 2024 led to deregistration of SIM cards of refugees and migrants without ID, leaving them cut off from mobile networks.

The Patriot reports Parliament passed the Refugees (Recognition and Management) Bill 23 of 2024, which provides for issuing identity cards (Omang) to every person granted refugee status, so they can register SIM cards and meet KYC.
